successors.name: German Africa
successors.text: Mandara in the Mandara Mountains and their northern plain round Mora and Dulo (the page gives no outline; a 70 km disc round Maroua, the nearest listed town, stands for it)

ledger.x: 1902: the contest with the Fulani ends in the German conquest ("In 1902, the kingdom was conquered by Germany").

wars.name: Mandara defeats Bornu
wars.outcome: "Around 1781, the Mandara defeated the kingdom of Borno in a major battle."

wars.name: Fulani jihad against Mandara
wars.outcome: Modibo Adama led a jihad against Mandara in 1809 ("the kingdom faced a setback in 1809") and the Fulani took it "in 1893".

wars.name: German conquest of Mandara
wars.outcome: "In 1902, the kingdom was conquered by Germany."

certainty.note: The page gives only the Mandara Mountains of Cameroon; the disc is a stand-in.
